title: A Place at the Edge
prose: Someone has set a small reed mat beneath the courtyard tree. The roots still have their ring of loose earth.

choices.label: Sit outside the root ring
choices.line: The courtyard has room for visitors because its oldest resident has room too.

choices.label: Notice the shade
choices.line: The repair makes space, rather than filling everything that was empty.
